sprints.title: release-plz configuration, the release workflow, the release-PR guard and their contracts

tasks.title: release-plz.toml and the release-automation contract group
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Before any change: `git fetch origin && git rebase origin/master` (see the checkpoint constraint).

Write `release-plz.toml` per RPZ-1, starting from RayX.CLI's file (`../RayX.CLI/release-plz.toml`): `[workspace]` keys including `git_release_enable = true`, `pr_branch_prefix = "release-plz-"`, `release_commits = "^(feat|fix|perf)"` and `semver_check = false`, each with a comment naming the 1.x policy (breaks are typed `feat`/`fix` with the break in the body and consumer notes in a `Migration:` footer; never `!` or `BREAKING CHANGE:`); `[[package]] name = "rayx-signalr"`; the CLI's `[changelog]` with the header naming `rayx-signalr`, a `docs(agentx)` skip parser added, and a `commit.footers` loop in the body that renders `Migration:` footers (align the template with the RayX.Dtcg pilot's if it already exists). Top-of-file comments say what release-plz does here (release PR, tag, GitHub Release; no registry) and point to `docs/releasing.md`.

Create `dotnet/RayX.SignalR.E2E.Tests/src/Contracts/ReleaseAutomationTests.cs` (`[Collection(AspireTestGroup.Name)]`, `AspireEnvironment.RepositoryRoot` only, never `EnsureStartedAsync`) with `[Trait("Case", "release-automation")]` on every fact: the configuration keys and `[changelog]` (`Category=Repository`), and a theory or fact that extracts the `release_commits` string, unescapes TOML `\\` to `\`, and asserts the accepted and rejected samples of RPZ-1. Follow the file style of the existing contracts (generated regexes, `AssertMatches`-style messages, `TreatWarningsAsErrors`).

tasks.title: release-plz.yml and the four-workflow contract
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Add `.github/workflows/release-plz.yml` per WF-1 from RayX.CLI's workflow (`../RayX.CLI/.github/workflows/release-plz.yml`), adapted: `master`, the repository guard `rayx-ui/RayX.SignalR`, `ubuntu-latest`, `actions/checkout@v7`, `rustup toolchain install 1.92.0 --profile minimal` instead of `actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain`, job names `release-plz / release` and `release-plz / release-pr`, top-level `permissions: contents: read`. Write the comments without the word `publish`.

Update `WorkflowContractTests.cs` per WF-2: `Workflows()` expects four files; `EveryWorkflowKeepsLeastPrivilegeGovernance` applies the write/secret/credential/action/concurrency exceptions only to `release-plz.yml`, allows its `master` push trigger (t03 adds `quality.yml`'s), and keeps everything else for all four. Add the `release-plz.yml` structure facts (WF-1) to `ReleaseAutomationTests.cs` with `Category=WorkflowContract` and `Case=release-automation`: triggers, job ids and names, guards, `needs: release` on `release-pr` (and none on `release`), permissions per job, checkout with `fetch-depth: 0` and the PAT, the toolchain step, `release-plz/action@v0.5` with each command, `GITHUB_TOKEN` from the PAT, `cancel-in-progress: false`, only `RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN`, and no `dotnet`, `aspire`, `pnpm`, `node`, `playwright` or `cargo test`.

tasks.title: Quality on master pushes; release pull requests skip the heavy jobs
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Add `push: branches: [master]` with `paths-ignore: [".agentx/**"]` to `quality.yml` (keep its `pull_request` trigger) per RPR-2; `e2e.yml` and `perf.yml` get no push trigger. Change `EveryWorkflowKeepsLeastPrivilegeGovernance` so `push` is allowed (only `master`) in exactly `quality.yml` and `release-plz.yml`, and add `WorkflowContract` + `Case=release-automation` facts on each workflow's trigger block.

Add the job-level conditions, directly under each job's `name:`/`runs-on:` lines: `if: ${{ !(startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-plz-') && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) }}` on every job of `e2e.yml` except `soak` and on `quality / unit-contract`; `if: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && !(startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-plz-') && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) }}` on the Quality jobs `native`, `wasm`, `android`, `ios`, `threaded-wasm`, `platform`, `rustdoc`, `dependency-security` and `contracts`; nothing on `rustfmt` and `clippy`. Change nothing else (ids, names, matrices, env, steps). Rewrite the top comments of `quality.yml` and `e2e.yml` to say which events start which jobs (push: rustfmt, clippy, unit tests; release PRs: rustfmt and clippy) and why.

Add `WorkflowContract` + `Case=release-automation` facts: each job (by id, from `JobBlocks`) has exactly its condition line; `rustfmt`, `clippy` and `soak` have none; the prefix in the line equals `pr_branch_prefix` in `release-plz.toml`. Run the whole `WorkflowContract` category to confirm the existing per-job facts still hold.

tasks.title: Local release-plz preview: release_commits, the 1.x policy and Cargo.lock
tasks.descriptionMarkdown:
Install current release-plz locally if missing (for example `cargo install --locked release-plz`; tool installs are the implementer's environment, not committed; ask before downloading if the session requires it). Clone this repository into the ignored `artifacts-temp/agentx/signalr-releases/scratch/` (or the system temp directory), copy in `release-plz.toml`, set `version = "1.0.0"`, write a CHANGELOG.md with the configured header and a `## [1.0.0]` section, commit, and tag `v1.0.0` locally (never push from the clone). Run every case of RPZ-2 with `release-plz update --config release-plz.toml`, resetting to the tag between cases; for case 5 remove or narrow a real public item in a `fix(client):` commit, and for case 4 write the break into the `feat(client):` body and end it with a `Migration: <note>` footer (no `!`, no `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer), and check the rendered line in CHANGELOG.md.

Note the Cargo.lock outcome for `docs/releasing.md` (t07). If `pr_branch_prefix` is rejected, remove it and make the t03 contract assert the literal default prefix instead. If release-plz needs a tracked `Cargo.lock`, stop and ask the owner. Record commands, tool versions and observed results in the handoff.

tasks.title: Verify RELEASE_PLZ_TOKEN and the rulesets
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Verify only; the owner created both on 2026-10-18 and nothing is created or changed here. Run `gh secret list --repo rayx-ui/RayX.SignalR` (names only), `gh api repos/rayx-ui/RayX.SignalR/rulesets` and `gh api repos/rayx-ui/RayX.SignalR/rulesets/<id>` for `Release tags` and `DefaultProtection`, and record the output per FIRST-1 (at planning time: secret set 2026-10-18T21:08:30Z; `Release tags` id 25358679; `DefaultProtection` id 24748651). Report any difference to the owner instead of changing it.

tasks.title: The single push that cuts v1.0.0
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Pre-approved by the owner (amendment 1); no go-ahead is needed for the push. If the `## [1.0.0]` date is not today, re-date it in a new commit (`docs(changelog): …`; never amend checkpointed commits). `git fetch origin`; confirm `git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/master HEAD` (else stop and ask); `git rebase origin/master`; `git push --force-with-lease origin master`. Watch the Release-plz and Quality runs of the push (Quality: only the light jobs run) (`gh run list --branch master`, `gh run watch`). If Release-plz fails at checkout or push, read the failing step: an authentication or 403/404 error means the shared PAT lacks access to RayX.SignalR, so report it to the owner (fix: add the repository to the PAT) and re-run (`gh run rerun <id>`) only after the owner confirms the fix; never retry blindly. A red Quality job goes through the repair loop with its narrowest selector. Verify FIRST-2 with `git ls-remote --tags origin v1.0.0`, `gh release view v1.0.0 --repo rayx-ui/RayX.SignalR --json tagName,isDraft,isPrerelease,body,targetCommitish`, `gh release list` (Latest), `gh pr list --repo rayx-ui/RayX.SignalR` and `gh run list` (Quality green, no End-to-end or Performance run for the push). Other repairs on GitHub (Release notes, a stray release PR, the by-hand fallback) only with the owner's go-ahead; record deviations.

tasks.descriptionMarkdown: In a new directory under the system temporary directory (outside every repository), create a library crate with an empty `[workspace]`, `rayx-signalr = { git = "https://github.com/rayx-ui/RayX.SignalR", tag = "v1.0.0" }` and a `lib.rs` that names `rayx_signalr::SignalRClient`. Run `cargo generate-lockfile` and `cargo check`; compare the lockfile's `source` and `version` with `git rev-parse v1.0.0^{commit}` per FIRST-3 and record the output. Delete the scratch directory afterwards.
